verdict.rationale: GitBook offers Git sync of markdown source content but no documented feature for exporting the full rendered site (theme, navigation, assets) as a static bundle for self-hosting elsewhere; probes for such export endpoints return 404. Community commentary explicitly describes lock-in concerns ('artificial barriers to just using the software... non open source behavior to only support their monthly service', 'abandoned open source spirit') and the CLI being deprecated, reinforcing that no portable static-export path exists.
